mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.created_time, n.feedback_id, n.feedback_time, n.feedback_type, n.reply, CASE WHEN nr.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_read FROM notice n LEFT JOIN notice_read nr ON n.notice_id = nr.notice_id AND nr.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.target_user_id IS NULL OR n.target_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_time DESC
